ask_rules.request_phrases: \b(please|can you|could you|would you|will you|i need|i want|i'd like|i would like|let's|lets|you should|we should|should be|must|need to|have to|is it possible|any way to|why don't you|why not)\b
ask_rules.note: heuristic; precision and recall measured by validate_ask_rules.py

method: structural segmentation (newlines, sentence terminators, semicolons, dash joins, list markers) with no semantic judgement; citation = a register quote appears as a substring of the unit; overlap = greedy long-first containment; the harness ask-only figure filters numerator and denominator identically and re-measures overlap on the reduced set
